yt_title: Women online in India: 33% to 64% in four years 📈

vo.title: In four years, the share of Indian women who have used the internet nearly doubled.
vo.rows: And it rose in every single state.
vo.movers: Andhra Pradesh tripled, from 21 percent to 63.6. Puducherry moved the least.
vo.end: When did you first go online? Tell us in the comments.
